definitions.explanation: A three-dimensional representation of a person, animal, or figure, created by carving, casting, or sculpting. Includes both traditional and modern sculptural works.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{彫像|ちょうぞう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}っている→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: A statue stands in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大理石|だいりせき}→大理石：20505_dairiseki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{彫像|ちょうぞう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A marble statue is exhibited at the art museum.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{平安|へいあん}→平安：12641_heian⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}られた→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{仏|ほとけ}→仏：03722_hotoke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{彫像|ちょうぞう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{数多|かずおお}く→数多く：12948_kazuooku⟧⟦{残|のこ}されている→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: This temple preserves numerous Buddhist statues made during the Heian period.

notes:
Composed of {彫|ちょう} (carve/engrave) + ⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧ (image/figure). Refers specifically to three-dimensional sculptural works, as opposed to flat reliefs or paintings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {彫像|ちょうぞう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make a statue
- {青銅|せいどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{彫像|ちょうぞう}: bronze statue
- ⟦{大理石|だいりせき}→大理石：20505_dairiseki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{彫像|ちょうぞう}: marble statue
- {仏|ぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{彫像|ちょうぞう}: Buddhist statue/sculpture

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧: statue/image — broader term, includes any representational figure
- ⟦{銅像|どうぞう}→銅像：14471_douzou⟧: bronze statue — specifically made of bronze
- {塑像|そぞう}: clay figure — made by molding rather than carving
- ⟦{彫刻|ちょうこく}→彫刻：04448_choukoku⟧: sculpture — the art form or practice, broader than {彫像|ちょうぞう}
